title: Invoice Opening and Billing Class Assignment under Patient Invoices & Statements
content:
A Patient Invoices & Statements invoice is opened for one order when the first amount the patient owes for that order is known, and it is classed by the billing class that produced the balance.

## 1. Opening and the first posting

| Kind of order | When the invoice opens | What is posted |
|---|---|---|
| Self-pay | When the order is placed or switched to self-pay | The sum of the self-pay prices of the order's tests that have not been credited |
| Consumer purchase | At purchase | The purchase price; the invoice is paid in full at purchase |
| Insured | At the first patient-responsibility assignment from a claim | That assignment; every later assignment for the same order posts to the same invoice |

The invoice's date of service is the order's collection date, or the order date for a prepaid consumer purchase.

## 2. Billing class

The billing class is chosen from the order's billing method and the payer class of the coverage that adjudicated:

| Order | Payer class that adjudicated | Billing class |
|---|---|---|
| Billing method self-pay | — | Self-Pay Patient Invoice |
| Consumer-initiated and prepaid | — | Consumer Test Purchase Invoice |
| Billing method insurance | Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | Out-of-Network Balance Invoice |
| Billing method insurance | Original Medicare Part B or Medicare Supplement Plan | Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice |
| Billing method insurance | Medicaid Managed Care Plan | Medicaid Copay Invoice |
| Billing method insurance | Every other payer class: Medicare Advantage Plan, TRICARE Prime and Select, Commercial In-Network Plan | Insured Patient Responsibility Invoice |

## 3. Medicare denials and the ABN

A Medicare medical-necessity or frequency denial may be posted to a Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice only when a signed ABN option 1 is on the order.

The ABN that counts is the one recorded on the same order the invoice bills, as the laboratory's order record shows it at the time of posting.

| Signed ABN option 1 on the billed order | Medicare medical-necessity or frequency denial posted to the Medicare Beneficiary Liability Invoice |
|---|---|
| Yes | May be posted |
| No (no ABN, an ABN with another option, or an ABN on a different order only) | May not be posted |

## 4. First statement

The first statement is issued the billing class's first-statement business days after the first posting. When the patient has a live secondary coverage that can still pay, the first statement first waits the class's secondary-payer days, counted in calendar days, and the business days are counted from the end of that wait.

| Live secondary coverage that can still pay | First statement date |
|---|---|
| No | The class's first-statement business days after the first posting |
| Yes | The class's first-statement business days after the end of a wait of the class's secondary-payer calendar days following the first posting |
